per_target_IF.flag_rule: hardest = the 10 largest seed-mean rank percentiles over the 60 targets; outside_15/20pct = seed-mean best rank beyond the budget

rank_metrics.note: file-level; positives = all files matching a target pattern; LOF is deterministic so its sd is 0; R-precision = share of positives in the top R (R = #positives)

IF_vs_OC-SVM.test: one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, H1: IF best-rank percentile < other (IF ranks the target higher)

IF_vs_LOF.test: one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank, H1: IF best-rank percentile < other (IF ranks the target higher)

bootstrap_spec.statistic: mean over targets of (fraction of seeds in which the target is in the top 20%)

model_comparison.note: percentile = seed-mean best rank / N; the 60 targets are pooled across disks, so disk difficulty is shared; targets within a disk are not independent of each other (same model fit)

runtime.note: feature building = multimodel_eval.build_features (final set incl. burst) from runs/imgN/artifacts, JSON already extracted; IF = standardise + fit (200 trees, sample 256, n_jobs=-1) + score all rows; SHAP = TreeSHAP on 1000 random flagged files (top 20%)
